cases.name: Jeanna Wilcoxen
cases.about:
Jeanna and her friends went to Trolley Park in Council Bluffs. Every day after school, they'd sit down, crack open a can of soda, and her friends would try to do anything to get her to laugh.”

"I'm not going to lie, her laugh was hilarious. It was so funny. Her laugh...it was a happy laugh, so it made you laugh, and then everyone started laughing,” said (her friend) Samantha Vasquez-Valasquez.
